ticker_news.title: Warren Buffett's Favorite Stock to Buy -- $78 Billion Purchased in Less Than 7 Years -- Is Absolutely Crushing the S&P 500 This Year
ticker_news.description: Warren Buffett has spent nearly $78 billion purchasing his favorite stock, Berkshire Hathaway, in less than seven years. This stock has outperformed the S&P 500 by over 21 percentage points year-to-date and 75 percentage points over the last five years. However, Berkshire Hathaway's stock is now trading at a premium, and Buffett has not purchased any shares in the second half of 2024, indicating that the stock may no longer be a bargain.
ticker_news.author: The Motley Fool

ticker_news.title: 2 Warren Buffett Dividend Stocks to Buy and Hold Forever
ticker_news.description: The article discusses the benefits of investing in dividend-paying stocks, particularly Apple and Visa, which are part of Warren Buffett's investment strategy. It highlights the companies' strong economic moats, growth potential, and dividend programs.
ticker_news.author: Prosper Junior Bakiny

ticker_news.title: US Stocks Likely To Open Lower After The Worst Selloff Since 2020: Tariff Announcement Was '100% Smoot Hawley Disguised As Thoughtful Policy,' Says Expert
ticker_news.description: U.S. stock futures declined on Friday after a broad market selloff on Thursday following the introduction of President Trump's tariffs. Experts criticized the tariffs as a 'Smoot Hawley disguised as thoughtful policy', which caused the market to plummet.
ticker_news.author: Rishabh Mishra
